ranking_basis: acquisition-pattern coverage and label-authority value, not brand popularity

gaps.recommended_future_target: A bounded reviewed pair of official sources with explicit GTIN/model/variant evidence
gaps.why: No reviewed cross-source matching corpus exists, while product identity and variant identity must remain separate.

gaps.recommended_future_target: A public source exposing stable explicitly labelled counters across two reviewed times
gaps.why: Lazada counters remain unresolved and Shopee access is paused, so velocity labels are not ready.

gaps.recommended_future_target: One bounded non-JIB public SPA whose bundle clues can be checked against an independently attributable public surface
gaps.why: JIB is the only domain-live app-bundle validation and endpoint naming alone is not evidence.

gaps.pattern_or_capability: Common change and drift event contract
gaps.recommended_future_target: A deterministic replay of one technique-profile change and one source-schema change
gaps.why: Profile invalidation exists, but there is no generic reviewed cross-domain drift-event corpus.

gaps.recommended_future_target: A deterministic accounting adapter for already-reviewed request ledgers, without live calls
gaps.why: YouTube quota budgeting is explicit, but comparable cost and latency evidence is otherwise absent.

gaps.pattern_or_capability: Reviewed source-boundary evidence for seeded domains
gaps.recommended_future_target: Select a future target only after a separate prompt based on the missing boundary pattern, not brand priority
gaps.why: TikTok and OTA entries are seeds/candidates, while LINE SHOPPING and NocNoc lack completed durable episodes.

gaps.recommended_future_target: Independent review of a small contradiction-rich semantic sample with explicit reviewer provenance
gaps.why: The Reviewed Learning Corpus intentionally does not fabricate Human Confirmation, limiting training-label authority.

gaps.recommended_future_target: A deterministic dry refresh plan for an already validated catalog technique
gaps.why: YouTube uploads planning is dry and commerce refresh behavior is not consistently reviewed.
